bug: Compares the method case-sensitively, so "get" is treated as non-idempotent
Downgrades every retryable status on a keyless POST, so a 429 becomes give_up instead of back_off
Ignores the idempotency key: a 5xx on POST gives up even when the server can de-duplicate
Treats PUT and DELETE as non-idempotent, so their 5xx responses give up instead of retrying
Treats 3xx redirects as success instead of raising ValueError
Marks 429 as non-retryable like every other 4xx
